title: Raiment
summary: RA'IMENT, noun [for arrayment. See Array and Ray.] 1. Clothing in general; vestments; vesture; garments. Genesis 24:53. Deuteronomy 8:4. Living, both food and raiment she supplies. 2. A single garment

inlines.v: RA'IMENT, noun [for arrayment. See Array and Ray.] 1. Clothing in general; vestments; vesture; garments. Genesis 24:53. Deuteronomy 8:4. Living, both food and raiment she supplies. 2. A single garment. [In this sense it is rarely used, and indeed is improper.]
